name: Alves Kablo
summary: Alves Kablo Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. specializes in the production and global distribution of cables, marketed under its Alves Kablo brand. The company's diverse product range features installation, underground, armored, halogen-free, custom-designed, control, aluminum, and solar cables. Established in 2014, its main operations are based in Ankara, Turkey.
